prompt: Up/down vote control for posts and comments.
shortDesc: Up/down vote with the score for a post (or a comment when comment-id is set); clicking the active arrow again removes the vote. Updates immediately and saves in the background. Vertical by default, horizontal with compact.

props.name: comment-id
props.description: Comment id, when voting on a comment.

styling.notes: Orange when upvoted, blue when downvoted, grey otherwise; Archivo tabular score.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'vote', postId, commentId?, value: 1 | -1 | 0, outputFormat: { ok: 'boolean', score: 'number', myVote: 'number' } }
